## Details

<a id="joystick_dir_ptrs"></a>
### [`joystick_dir_ptrs`](../../../../src/input/move_select.asm#L6) `$CC82-$CC85`

*data*

Pointers to the joystick direction list of each facing ($91,x).

- **Read by:** [`read_joystick`](joystick.md#read_joystick)

<a id="joystick_dirs_0"></a>
### [`joystick_dirs_0`](../../../../src/input/move_select.asm#L9) `$CC86-$CC8E`

*data*

9 joystick directions: none, forward, back, down, up, down-forward, up-forward, down-back, up-back. $84e9 finds the index.

- **Referred to by:** [`ai_choose_moves`](../ai/computer_moves.md#ai_choose_moves)
- **Entry of:** [`joystick_dir_ptrs`](../../tables.md#joystick_dir_ptrs)

<a id="joystick_dirs_1"></a>
### [`joystick_dirs_1`](../../../../src/input/move_select.asm#L12) `$CC8F-$CC97`

*data*

The same list for facing 1: left and right are swapped.

- **Entry of:** [`joystick_dir_ptrs`](../../tables.md#joystick_dir_ptrs)

<a id="move_rows_no_fire"></a>
### [`move_rows_no_fire`](../../../../src/input/move_select.asm#L15) `$CC98-$CCB3`

*data*

Move selection row of each move number when fire is not pressed.

- **Read by:** [`find_move_row`](joystick.md#find_move_row)

<a id="move_rows_fire"></a>
### [`move_rows_fire`](../../../../src/input/move_select.asm#L21) `$CCB4-$CCCF`

*data*

Move selection row of each move number when fire is pressed.

- **Read by:** [`find_move_row`](joystick.md#find_move_row)

<a id="move_select_rows"></a>
### [`move_select_rows`](../../../../src/input/move_select.asm#L27) `$CCD0-$CD3B`

*data*

Move selection rows, 9 bytes each (12 rows): the next move for each direction index of joystick_dirs. $84f7 reads row n at $ccd0+9n.

- **Referred to by:** [`find_move_row`](joystick.md#find_move_row)
